title: Handoff to Backend Developer (OpenCode)
summary: Phased build order, ground rules, assumptions, out-of-scope list and implementation pitfalls for building the ESG Lens backend API.
notes: Prose/checklist handoff guide with sequencing, ground rules and definitions of done. Contains SPEC-like constraints (rate limits, model choices, config-over-constants) but defers all schemas/formulas/routes to architecture.md, data_model.md, scoring_methodology.md and api_design.md, so classified as DOC rather than SPEC. Sections 2 and 3 (assumptions, out-of-scope) carry PRD-like scope signal but no user stories or acceptance criteria.
